_note: Hero 12 (docs/plans/design/rebuild-heroes.md section 8j; rebuild-phase8-last-heroes.md 8f-4). Stats, mana, Mirror, and Unreal are the design's; Glimmer's 1.2s cooldown is a first number, as Ilse's and Ottilie's. He can't be drafted until his paths come.
name: Lucan Merrow
title: the illusionist

basic_attack.name: Glimmer
basic_attack.text: A shard of light at the nearest enemy within 3 hexes. His main source of mana.

signature.name: Mirror
signature.text: A copy of him appears beside him for a few seconds, with a share of his stats; it casts Glimmer but no signature.

passives.name: Unreal
passives.text: Enemies attacking him miss now and then.
